batches.name: Catalog and accepted price baseline
batches.caps: CAP-CAT-003, CAP-CAT-004, CAP-CAT-005, CAP-CAT-006, CAP-CAT-008, CAP-MER-003, CAP-PRC-004
batches.first: Select one Store-local Product/Variant + one published Listing/Offer + immutable Quote; postpone shared master propagation, dynamic schemas, inheritance, multi-channel targeting and media/i18n; choose a separately explicit demo tax policy.
batches.alts: A — constrained initial Store catalog with a truthful demo-tax contract (recommended); B — fully implement multi-store master/local inheritance and extensible attributes; C — manually fixed price/stock without explicit catalog/Offer/Quote (reject: violates CommerceCore domain identity).
batches.consequence: A preserves ratified one-store sale with smaller surface; B improves early framework breadth but raises Catalog/Cloud requirements; C creates an eGame-only shortcut and must not be accepted.
batches.blockers: Tax treatment and truthful total is a G3 input, but media/master overrides are not first-sale blockers.
batches.exit: Approve each of seven dispositions, select valid demo tax/quote contract with no live-tax claim; direct R0.2-07/R0.3-03/R0.3-08 references noted.

batches.name: Actor security and CommerceCloud boundary
batches.caps: CAP-SEC-001, CAP-SEC-002, CAP-SEC-003, CAP-SEC-011, CAP-CLOUD-001, CAP-CLOUD-004, CAP-CLOUD-008
batches.first: Approve trusted Store/buyer/operator authorization, guest/session protection and a controlled initial Store configuration. Separately decide whether complete Keycloak realms, OIDC BFF, admin MFA or independently running Cloud storage are necessary in initial testmode.
batches.alts: A — smallest explicit actor/session/Control Plane port satisfying every security invariant, with physical infrastructure decisions flagged (recommended); B — full multi-tenant self-service and realm provisioning in first vertical; C — no auth/security because testmode (reject).
batches.consequence: A retains authorization and avoids premature Cloud provisioning; B brings full platform lifecycle forward; C exposes key/refund/tenant failures.
batches.blockers: Guest claim/cancellation/key access authorization and privileged operator session MUST be decided before M04; provisioning UI need not.
batches.exit: Ratify role-action matrix, operator MFA/session approach and CommerceCloud-to-Core authority boundary without forcing Cloud private DB writes.

batches.name: Buyer status, operational evidence and administration
batches.caps: CAP-ORD-009, CAP-INV-007, CAP-EGAME-007, CAP-EGAME-009, CAP-ADMIN-001, CAP-ADMIN-002, CAP-ADMIN-007, CAP-ADMIN-008
batches.contexts: Ordering, Inventory, Fulfillment, eGame, Administration, Security
batches.first: Require durable financial history, current-order buyer status and auditable privileged recovery, while avoiding full admin consoles and broad stock editing; define minimum accessibility acceptance.
batches.alts: A — mandatory domain evidence and minimal privileged commands with narrowly scoped UI (recommended); B — full catalog/tenant/admin dashboards and history screens; C — entirely no operator/audit capability (reject).
batches.consequence: A keeps safe reconciliation and exposure history; B increases UI footprint; C violates unknown-payment and refund accountability.
batches.blockers: Authoritative history, guest-buyer status, safe incident controls and accessible core actions block completion; UI breadth does not.
batches.exit: Ratify the eight CAP dispositions and composite separation; link authority, audit integrity, accessibility and security test oracles.

batches.name: Optional purchase notifications
batches.first: Permit authenticated/claimed order status and key access without an email channel; avoid revealing keys in messages; plan messaging later.
batches.alts: A — defer all optional email/provider/template delivery until a separately approved milestone (recommended); B — include safe notice-only emails in M04; C — send license keys in email (reject).
batches.consequence: A simplifies initial delivery while maintaining an active buyer status channel; B needs durable messaging and no-key privacy validation; C breaches license confidentiality policy.
batches.blockers: No optional email feature blocks the first testmode sale, but secure on-site access must exist.
batches.exit: User decides notifications' release timing without altering D-05 mandatory financial Outbox.

batches.name: Engineering governance and release constraints
batches.priority: P1 / M01 plus M04 operational quality
batches.first: Keep spending authorization and internal contract compatibility as early design foundations; separately decide public open-source license and initial recovery/alert acceptance targets.
batches.alts: A — early governance controls and testmode recovery objectives; defer full SDK/SRE rollout (recommended); B — full public framework release and production SLOs before eGame; C — omit version/cost/observability controls (reject).
batches.consequence: A prevents accidental spending, source drift and uninvestigable operations; B slows initial learning; C contradicts accepted governance and commercial recovery.
batches.blockers: Basic safe operational observability and contract versions block M04 acceptance; exact public license blocks distribution rather than the test purchase.
batches.exit: Approve four dispositions, choose public license before publication and explicit initial recovery objective or retain a named blocker.

batches.name: Stripe wallet/Link composite (outside the 29)
batches.priority: P1 / before provider config in M04
batches.first: Keep wallets deferred and Stripe Link PENDING until the actual provider configuration explicitly enforces accepted initial card/3DS instruments.
batches.alts: A — confirm card/3DS-only provider methods in testmode, Link remains disabled until ratified (recommended); B — ratify effective Link conditions separately; C — rely on Stripe default dynamic methods without review (reject).
batches.consequence: A respects D-03 while maintaining a complete hosted checkout; B may widen provider scope and tests; C risks unauthorized payment methods.
batches.blockers: Actual method enforcement D-03-CONFIG is a M04 design requirement even if Link excluded.
batches.exit: Do not alter D-03-WALLET DEFERRED or D-03-LINK PENDING without explicit provider-side evidence and user decision.
